# adlc_user (Resource)

Manages an Active Directory user account by executing PowerShell on a remote Windows host.

This resource owns the account's `enabled` state. Enabling an account that has no usable password sets a throwaway strong random password (never stored in state) purely so the account can be enabled; a password-management resource can later set the real password without changing the enabled state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "adlc_user" "jdoe" {
  name                = "John Doe"
  sam_account_name    = "jdoe"
  user_principal_name = "jdoe@contoso.local"
  path                = "Contoso/Users"

  given_name   = "John"
  surname      = "Doe"
  display_name = "John Doe"
  email        = "john.doe@contoso.local"
  title        = "Systems Engineer"
  department   = "IT"
  company      = "Contoso"
  manager      = adlc_user.jsmith.id

  # Enabled on its own: with no password set, the resource sets a throwaway random
  # password (never stored in state) so the account can be enabled. A password-management
  # resource can set the real password afterwards without changing the enabled state.
  enabled = true
}

resource "adlc_user" "jsmith" {
  name                = "Jane Smith"
  sam_account_name    = "jsmith"
  user_principal_name = "jsmith@contoso.local"
  path                = "Contoso/Users"

  given_name   = "Jane"
  surname      = "Smith"
  display_name = "Jane Smith"
  title        = "IT Manager"
  department   = "IT"
  company      = "Contoso"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) User name (the `CN`). Changing this renames the user in place.
- `path` (String) Container holding the user. Accepts a slash-delimited path relative to the domain root (for example `Users` or `Contoso/Users`), a relative distinguished name such as `CN=Users`, or a full distinguished name. Slash segments are always OU names. Changing this moves the user.
- `sam_account_name` (String) Pre-Windows 2000 logon name. Unique domain-wide, maximum 20 characters.
- `user_principal_name` (String) User principal name, for example `jdoe@contoso.local`.

### Optional

- `account_expiration_date` (String) Date the account expires, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Omit for an account that never expires. AD stores this as a timestamp, so the value read back may shift by the local UTC offset.
- `cannot_change_password` (Boolean) Prevent the user from changing their own password.
- `city` (String) Town or city (`l`).
- `company` (String) Company.
- `country` (String) Country, as a 2-letter ISO 3166 code.
- `department` (String) Department.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `division` (String) Division.
- `email` (String) Email address (`mail`).
- `employee_id` (String) Employee ID.
- `employee_number` (String) Employee number.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the account is enabled. This resource enforces the value: enabling an account with no usable password sets a throwaway strong random password (never stored in state) so it can be enabled. A password-management resource may later set the real password.
- `fax` (String) Fax number.
- `given_name` (String) Given (first) name.
- `home_directory` (String) Home directory UNC path.
- `home_drive` (String) Drive letter mapped to `home_directory`, for example `H:`.
- `home_page` (String) Web page address (`wWWHomePage`).
- `home_phone` (String) Home telephone number.
- `initials` (String) Initials.
- `logon_workstations` (String) Comma-separated NetBIOS names of workstations the user may log on from. Empty means any workstation.
- `manager` (String) Manager of this user. Accepts a distinguished name, `objectGUID`, SID, `DOMAIN\name` or `sAMAccountName`. The resolved distinguished name is published as `manager_dn`.
- `mobile_phone` (String) Mobile telephone number (`mobile`).
- `office` (String) Office location (`physicalDeliveryOfficeName`).
- `office_phone` (String) Office telephone number.
- `organization` (String) Organization (`o`).
- `other_name` (String) Middle name (`middleName`).
- `password_never_expires` (Boolean) Exempt the account's password from the domain's maximum password age.
- `po_box` (String) Post office box.
- `postal_code` (String) Postal or ZIP code.
- `profile_path` (String) Roaming profile path.
- `protected_from_accidental_deletion` (Boolean) Protect the user from accidental deletion. This is not a stored attribute: it adds Deny access control entries for `Everyone` on `Delete` and `DeleteTree`.
- `script_path` (String) Logon script path.
- `smart_card_logon_required` (Boolean) Require a smart card for interactive logon.
- `state` (String) State or province (`st`).
- `street_address` (String) Street address.
- `surname` (String) Surname (last name).
- `title` (String) Job title.
- `trusted_for_delegation` (Boolean) Trust the account for Kerberos delegation.

### Read-Only

- `distinguished_name` (String) Distinguished name of the user. Changes when the user is renamed or moved.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. Equals the user `objectGUID`, which is stable across renames and moves.
- `manager_dn` (String) Resolved distinguished name of `manager`.
- `sid` (String) Security identifier of the user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Users are imported by objectGUID, which is stable across renames and moves.
terraform import adlc_user.jdoe "b3f2b9a0-1234-4a85-a7a3-9bcbb6a41d02"
```
